narr.Aqua Roma: W42 users 5,272, up 0.8 per cent on the week and 19.6 per cent below last year, with 128 GA4 bookings against 334 last year. GA4's booking event was dead from 16 to 20 October and recovered on Wednesday 21 October, so the W42 booking and conversion points cover five days of the seven. SevenRooms took 86 website bookings on 19 and 20 October against 5 GA4 events, so read the shortfall as a measurement gap and not as demand. Meta, Google and walk-in panels are unaffected. On the five tracked days GA4 ran at 1.48 times the SevenRooms website booking count against a pre-break norm of 1.59 to 1.70, so the event is recording properly again. Meta delivered 59 bookings at $31 and Google 16 at $44, Google's best count since W39 on provisional figures that will settle upward. All booking points on this panel are rebuilt on the create path and the last-year line is restricted to Aqua's own venue paths, so they do not tie to the figures published before w2026-10-12. The last-year walk-in points are gaps: the account returned no Store visits or Local actions rows from the end of September 2025.
narr.Aqua Kyoto: W42 users 761 with 12 GA4 bookings, down from 22 the week before; conversion rate 1.6 per cent. narr.Hutong NYC: W42 users 5,574, up 11.6 per cent on the week and 32.9 per cent above last year, with 90 GA4 bookings against 205 last year. There is now a last-year booking comparison at W42: the 2025 tracking outage ran to 14 October, so the week of 20 to 26 October 2025 is complete and is published, while W39, W40 and W41 stay as gaps. On the five tracked days GA4 ran at 1.00 times the SevenRooms website booking count against a norm of 1.12 to 1.15. narr.Hutong Miami: W42 users 3,835, down 5.8 per cent on the week and 23.6 per cent above last year, with 31 GA4 bookings against 75 last year. GA4's booking event was dead from 16 to 20 October and recovered on Wednesday 21 October, so the W42 booking and conversion points cover five days of the seven. SevenRooms took 86 website bookings on 19 and 20 October against 5 GA4 events, so read the shortfall as a measurement gap and not as demand. Meta, Google and walk-in panels are unaffected. This is the one venue still sitting meaningfully below its own pre-break ratio, 0.85 times the SevenRooms website booking count against a norm of 1.22 to 1.29, a gap of about 13 bookings over five days, so recheck it next week. Meta gave back last week's gain, 22 bookings at $75 against 50 at $33, and Google delivered 5 at $103 with no delivery at all on 22 October. Last week's Google reading held at 9.0, so the settling pattern is weaker here than at Hutong NYC.
